_doc: THE SPECIAL PAYLOAD TABLE - the hole P4-C1's completeness pass found and P5-C3 fills. encounters.json has a SPECIAL row for every network category (4-10 % of every scan) and until this file existed the pack carried nothing behind it: no roster, no ids, no per-category weights. It is shaped EXACTLY like ITEM_DROPS - a roster plus per-category weights summing to 100 - so encounters.cpp resolves SPECIAL with the same two-stage pick it uses for ITEM, and both get the same generated guards. Roster and weights live in ONE file on purpose: items.json and balance.json's ITEM_DROPS are the same table split across two files, and nobody can read that one whole.
_kinds_doc: Exactly the two outcomes the plan's own P5-C3 bullet promises, and no third invented here: XP_BURST pays SPECIAL_XP_SCALE * value experience, CORRUPTION sets PBS_CORRUPTED on the active Bug for CORRUPTION.duration_s. Several EVENTS may share a kind - that is what stops HIDDEN's 10 % slice being one repeated line - but a kind with no event is a branch encounters.cpp could never reach, and gen_content.py refuses it.

_weights_doc: Per network category, summing to exactly 100, same rule as ITEM_DROPS and encounters.json - so a SPECIAL is a plain 0..99 draw with no normalisation step to get wrong. A zero weight is not written as 0: the row is left out, which is what the generated guard checks.
